description: Optimisation of the GTSIO-520-H R10 study file (scripts/optimize_model.mjs, 20-bit positions), rebuilt on 20 October 2026 from the source with the piston skirt relief (docs/r10-cycle-overlap-root-causes.md). The file keeps the name gtsio520-r10-static-opt1.glb.gz; the release it replaces (Drive id 10AXTDqplLyTAjXp-wTikbdx7BGg5Dwf4, decoded sha256 1dcf07ccd0f2) stays on Drive and in the manifest's previous_web_releases. See docs/model-optimization.md.

derivedFrom.note: Not a published file. The unoptimised release below with Piston1 to Piston6 replaced by scripts/graft_gtsio_r10_pistons.mjs (FreeCAD pistons with the neighbour-bay skirt relief, 20 October 2026); the other 1,390 parts are unchanged byte for byte.

settings.note: Position mantissa raised from the default 16 bits to 20 so every part stays a closed solid for the exact-intersection audit.

models.renderCheckNote: R10 has no baked animation and no morph targets, so the 12 pictures are 3 distinct rest views (iso, front, top) drawn four times; the viewer's computed cycle and explosion poses were not rendered. Their geometry comes from the same vertex data, and the exact-intersection audit of the same poses found the same 159 overlapping pairs before and after optimising.

parseTime.where: desktop Chrome, best of three, app loader
